chestPages.travelingCalc:
Traveling uses a special function to calculate drop rates for Agility Chests rather than the fixed per action rate in other activities. This is to prevent farming of chests through constant short trips.
(0.096736 × 2) × (2.718280.0165921 × ''Buffed Skill Level'') × ''Distance''

IntroString.Inventory:
The Mysterious Merchant will buy items that come from chests, and give you chest-specific chips in exchange that you can use to buy other chest items.

You don't need to bring what you want to sell with you, the Mysterious Merchant can pull items directly from your bank.

PageDesc.mysteriousMerchant: The '''Mysterious Merchant''' offers the service of trading chest loot for chest specific chips and then selling chest loot for the ships. There is a 1:4 rate between selling and buying.
PageDesc.wardrobe: The '''Wardrobe''' service allows your character to change or apply different [[Special:MyLanguage/Cosmetics|cosmetics]] you have gained or purchased. Wardrobes are generally available in every city.
PageDesc.mailbox:
The '''Mailbox''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Services|service]] that allows players to receive mail and claim attached items.

Mailboxes are available in locations that have a [[Special:MyLanguage/Banks|bank]] available. The Mailbox can also be opened from the inventory, but items may only be claimed while at a full service bank.

The mailbox was introduced as part of the wider development of upcoming trading features, but as of now trading and sending items or mail to other players are not possible. The Mailbox currently provides a way for the developers to send mail, rewards, and other surprises to players, and it is planned to support future systems such as trade deliveries and event rewards.
